class.name: OcgShapeupgradeSplitsurface
class.brief_description: Splits a Surface with a criterion.
class.description: ! Splits a Surface with a criterion.

method.name: Init_2
method.description: Initializes with single supporting surface with bounding parameters.

method.name: SetUSplitValues
method.description: Sets U parameters where splitting has to be done

method.name: SetVSplitValues
method.description: Sets V parameters where splitting has to be done

method.name: Build
method.description: Performs splitting of the supporting surface. If resulting surface is B-Spline and Segment is True, the result is composed with segments of the surface bounded by the U and V SplitValues (method Geom_BSplineSurface::Segment is used). If Segment is False, the result is composed with Geom_RectangularTrimmedSurface all based on the same complete surface. Fields myNbResultingRow and myNbResultingCol must be set to specify the size of resulting grid of surfaces.

method.name: Compute
method.description: Calculates points for correction/splitting of the surface.

method.name: Perform
method.description: Performs correction/splitting of the surface. First defines splitting values by method Compute(), then calls method Build().

method.name: USplitValues
method.description: returns all the U splitting values including the First and Last parameters of the input surface

method.name: VSplitValues
method.description: returns all the splitting V values including the First and Last parameters of the input surface

method.name: Status
method.description: Returns the status OK - no splitting is needed DONE1 - splitting required and gives more than one patch DONE2 - splitting is required, but gives only single patch (initial) DONE3 - geometric form of the surface or parametrisation is modified

method.name: ResSurfaces
method.description: Returns obtained surfaces after splitting as CompositeSurface
